content: Warm golden-hour coastal neighborhood, terracotta tiled roofs, aged cream/coral plaster, cobbled streets, dark wrought iron, shop awnings, greenery and amber practical lighting. Human-scale dense urban life; atmospheric realism is art direction, not required photorealistic rendering.

Dark translucent framed HUD, pale legible text, amber mission markers, teal selection/energy, red health. Top status strip, left mission/social panels, upper-right minimap, bottom inventory and key hints, phone at right. Contains concept-only interactions and place names that must be replaced by working Kıyıyaka systems.

Coastal district organized around a central park, commercial waterfront, residential interior, clinic/police/school/garage service anchors and connected main/secondary roads. Image labels and route arrows are concept references, not executable geometry or navigation data.

Twelve adult archetypes with recognizable silhouettes: student, shopkeeper, taxi driver, mechanic, police officer, office worker, gang member, business owner, journalist, courier, unemployed resident and elderly neighbor. Stylized realism with modular contemporary clothing and readable colors; do not assign criminality from appearance or unemployment.

Modular isometric apartment facades, balconies, red tile roofs, shops, clinic, police, garage, street furniture, trees, road/crosswalk/sidewalk tiles, cars/taxis/scooters/vans/bus and walls/stairs. Sheet is a design reference with inconsistent illustrative spacing; generate actual padded atlas frames and validated footprints separately.
